ra.swallowing.title: Dynamic MRI research reference · separate source
ra.swallowing.caption: Published MRI teaching montage from a healthy-volunteer source cohort. Individual subject identity, age and sex are not supplied. Seven sagittal-style panels in source reading order; this is a separate research case, not this examination’s VFSS.
ra.swallowing.limits: Stored MRI grid2×2×6mm and seven slices. Sliding-window combination and temporal regularisation mean the published≈12fps reconstruction is not independent12fps sampling. Display movie frames are not raw MRI intensities/affines or validated 3D tissue labels. No source phase classification, aspiration exclusion, pressure, unique mechanism, current-patient registration or clinical/anatomical coverage is approved. Source supplement says Figure6 while the article links Figure4; discrepancy retained.
ra.swallowing.attribution: Luuk Voskuilen, Jasper Schoormans, Oliver J. Gurney-Champion, Alfons J. M. Balm, Gustav J. Strijkers, Ludi E. Smeele, Aart J. Nederveen. Dynamic MRI of swallowing. DOI 10.1007/s10334-021-00973-6. Original Supplementary ESM2, CC BY4.0. Browser adaptation: lossless VP9 transport, all64 decoded RGB frames unchanged; container timestamp rounding below1ms. Original MPEG4 movie retained.

ra.tinnitus.title: Processed 4D-CTA MIP source motion · separate case
ra.tinnitus.caption: Processed 4D-CTA MIP display from the published right sigmoid-sinus dAVF example associated with source Figure2. Age, sex and acquisition clock are not supplied. This is a separate published case, not the current patient.
ra.tinnitus.limits: Twelve encoded display frames at3fps; original acquisition interval, bolus clock, pulse/ECG synchronization, calibration and native intermodal registration are unverified. Segmented inverted CT angiographic MIP, not a native CT volume, raw tissue intensities or registered 3D mesh. Original RGB555 video and decoded samples are retained; the lossless browser transport preserves every decoded RGB frame without contrast harmonisation, resizing or temporal interpolation.
